claim: Saleor is a GraphQL-native, API-only commerce platform
Per-channel control of pricing, currencies and stock
Extensions through webhooks, metadata, apps and dashboard iframes, technology-agnostic
Orders support split payments, multi-warehouse and returns
Promotion engine: sales, vouchers, cart rules, gift cards
saleor-platform runs API, storefront and dashboard together locally
Dashboard is a separate repository, and an example storefront is built with Next.js
Saleor Cloud is a managed offer from the project
main branch is the development version and may be unstable; use release tags; use the same 3.x version for all three components
README states the service-oriented approach may feel more complex for a small low-traffic business
